blocks.title: DesignCraft in the activity panel
blocks.description: Spreads, parent pages and threaded text frames — the upstream DesignCraft publishing editor running inside Astravia, with the document you opened in the workspace.

showcase.assistant_reply: DesignCraft is open. Select the file in the Explorer, then press Open — it takes that file.

items.title: The real layout engine
items.description: The panel serves the official DesignCraft web build byte for byte; upstream's wasm and JavaScript are not patched, and only two thin files of ours are added around them.

items.title: Open and export inside your project
items.description: Opening uses the file selected in the Explorer, and exports are written back through Astravia instead of landing in a downloads folder.

items.title: Ask for the current page
items.description: A capture tool saves a PNG of what the canvas is showing, and a status tool reports whether the editor actually finished starting.

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: About 26 MB of editor files arrive on first open, into the plugin's data directory, and are reused offline after that.

items.title: Open the DesignCraft tab
items.description: The preparation screen is the hub fetching its payload; later opens start from cache.

items.title: Select a document, then open it
items.description: File → Open inside the editor takes the file selected in Astravia rather than showing a system dialog.

items.title: Export back through the workspace
items.description: Exports travel the same bridge as saves, so the result lands where you chose.

blocks.content: DesignCraft describes itself as pre-alpha: expect missing features and changing files. The plugin runs whatever the pinned release does — it does not add layout features of its own.
In the browser entry points there is no workspace binding: opening a file there uses the browser's picker and exports download through the browser.
Interface language: the editor itself is English only — upstream ships no other language. The tab shell, the preparation page and this page follow your Astravia language.
